name: Úbeda (Spain)
description: Garnet field charged towards the hoist with the arms of the city of Úbeda (a crowned white shield with twelve red lions around a yellow crown).
history: As published in the Boletín Oficial de la Junta de Andalucía, the flag of Úbeda consists of a rectangular cloth with a proportion between width and length of 3 to 5, garnet, with the arms of the city centred vertically and set towards the hoist. The arms were granted by Henry III of Castile on 12 August 1369, the twelve lions referring to the knights of Úbeda present at the battle.

features.role: Úbeda arms — twelve red lions around a crown on white
